title: Too many clicks required to run a recent application
line: Kickoff's sidebar now has Recent Applications and Recent Files categories right below Favorites, so a recent app is two clicks away instead of four.
explanation: Kickoff only showed recent apps and files under Places > History, so opening a recent app took four clicks (open, Places, History, app). Kickoff's sidebar comes from Kicker's RootModel with the recent groups turned off, and RootModel added the Favorites placeholder before the recent groups, so turning them on would have pushed Favorites down; Kickoff also hardcoded row 1 as All Applications. RootModel now adds Favorites last so it stays first, and gives recent apps a compact name like other app rows. Kickoff turns on Recent Applications and Recent Files (sidebar: Favorites, Recent Applications, Recent Files, All Applications, categories), finds All Applications by its model instead of by row, and stores the two switches in its config with checkboxes in the settings, as Kicker does, so the existing 'Hide Recent …' context action sticks and can be undone.

commits.message:
applets/kicker: keep Favorites above the recent categories

Kickoff needs Favorites as the first sidebar row, but its placeholder
was added before the recent groups and so ended up below them. Add it
last, and give recent apps a compact name like other app entries.

BUG: 442981

applets/kickoff: show recent applications and files in the sidebar

Recent apps and files were only reachable through Places > History,
four clicks away. Show them as categories right below Favorites; like
in Kicker, they can be hidden from their context menu or the settings.
